body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
Circle's OCC bank charter approval and Tether's GENIUS Act compliance push are reshaping the U.S. stablecoin landscape as USDC circulation tops $73B.
Stablecoin News
Circle Gets OCC Bank Charter Approval
Circle can now manage USDC reserves directly as a nationally chartered bank; shares surged as stablecoin competition with Tether intensifies.
Tether Faces GENIUS Act Compliance Deadline
USDT's future on U.S. platforms hinges on meeting GENIUS Act requirements before the compliance window closes; offshore USDT currently sits outside the law's reserve rules.
Tether Pushes USAT to Challenge Circle in the US
Tether's Anchorage Digital Bank-issued USAT token, launched to comply with GENIUS Act rules, is ramping up its US market entry against Circle's USDC.
ECB Official Warns Stablecoins Could Drain Bank Deposits
A European Central Bank board member flagged deposit-flight risk from stablecoin growth, briefly pressuring Coinbase and Circle shares.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Triple-A Treasury Drained of $11.8M Across 7 Chains

Singapore stablecoin payments firm Triple-A confirmed a 31-hour treasury wallet breach spanning Ethereum, TRON, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana, TON and Bitcoin; client funds held in segregated trust accounts were unaffected.
AFX Bridge Exploit Drains $24M on Arbitrum
Attackers compromised private keys from five validators to hit quorum and drain USDC from an AFX-powered bridge, converting proceeds to ~12,467 ETH.
Two Cross-Chain Bridges Hacked in One Day, $31.5M Lost
A single day saw two separate bridge exploits combine for $31.5M in losses, pushing July's total crypto hack tally toward $97M.
H1 2026 Crypto Hacks Hit Record 207 Incidents
TRM Labs reports a record incident count in H1 2026, though total losses fell to $972M; compromised accounts now drive over half of DeFi attacks, overtaking smart contract exploits.
